instruction.text: Read this paragraph and answer the question.

atoms.text: You may not know it, but cheese has been around for a long, long time. Cheese has existed since around 8,000 BC. That’s about 10,000 years ago. The discovery of cheese probably happened by accident, when farmers began milking sheep and goats and left buckets of milk out in the sun. In the sun, the milk began to sour and turn bad. However, the farmers noticed that when they got rid of the extra liquid there were small lumps that made a tasty snack. These small lumps are called curds. Cheese curds are sour milk at the beginning of the ageing process. If you let cheese curds sit and age, eventually you will get cheese.

instruction.text: Read this paragraph and answer the question.

atoms.text: Cheese was an important discovery for people at this time, because cheese contains many proteins and nutrients. Cheese can also be kept for a long time which was useful in times of need. If it wasn’t a good farming season, people did not have to worry as much because they could eat their cheese supply. Cheese has been around for so long that one of the first discovered pieces of writing was a log of cheese records.

The main topic of this paragraph is why cheese smells.
The main topic of this paragraph is why cheese is so delicious.

instruction.text: Read this paragraph and answer the question.

atoms.text: Over time, cheese began to be spread through trade, and many, different cultures began to create their own new, exciting kinds of cheese. The Roman Empire sent out dry cheese to their soldiers as a part of their rations. After the fall of the Roman Empire, monks throughout Europe began experimenting with cheese-making. They tested different milks, ageing processes and other ingredients to see how this would change the final product. From their experiments these monks created many types of cheese that we know and love today such as Parmesan and Munster cheese.
